create_InstanceImageGoalNavEpisode: create an InstanceImageGoalNavEpisode with a goal object ID and goal image ID for navigation
create_InstanceImageGoalSensor: create an InstanceImageGoalSensor that renders image goals from camera parameters in a HabitatSim dataset
create_InstanceImageGoalHFOVSensor: create an InstanceImageGoalHFOVSensor that returns the horizontal field of view for the current episode goal
register_InstanceImageNavigationTask: register the InstanceImageNav-v1 task for navigating to a specific object instance using a goal image
create_InstanceImageGoal: create an InstanceImageGoal with a list of InstanceImageParameters for camera-based image goal generation
